conflicts.conflict: 22 marketed grips versus 28 authored physical surface regions.
conflicts.ruling: 28 is the number of disjoint selectable patches, 14 per half; aliases and simultaneous pinch surfaces are documented. Do not pretend marketing positions equal independent physical holds.

conflicts.conflict: Retail40 × 13cm/270g lacks per-unit/assembly definition; other listings mix package or other-board dimensions.
conflicts.ruling: Do not transplant or claim these as calibrated Pivot dimensions. Overall scale remains explicitly photo-derived and PARTIAL.

conflicts.conflict: Depth guide bottom L→R ranges appear reversed when applied to delivered upright left half.
conflicts.ruling: The lower diagram is a 180-degree rotation of the same half. Reverse its range order in base-left coordinates; preserve handedness during right-half mirroring.

conflicts.conflict: Four marketed orientations but guide also includes a side-switch intermediate state.
conflicts.ruling: Export five preferred position records, including independent side translations for 3switch and4; no redundant contact meshes.
